blocks.html:
The Laboratory of Modern Languages - USI's University language centre - offers language courses aligned with the CEFR Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. Each course aims to develop oral and written comprehension and oral and written production skills. Some courses are open to external users for a fee and subject to availability on the Lugano campus.

For further information and registration, please refer to the accordion below.

Language courses offers, Lugano Campus

  • Intermediate, upper intermediate and advanced language courses (intensive pre-semester and semester-time) at CEFR level B1, B2 and C1 for Italian, French, German ane English languages.
  • Exam preparation courses for internationally recognized language certifications, including IELTS B2/C1 (English), Goethe-Zertifikat C1 (German), and DELF B2 (French). These courses are specifically designed to prepare participants for the corresponding exams.
  • Ancient languages: the Faculty of Theology of Lugano offers courses in ancient languages as part of its academic programs.

To explore the course offerings and course fees, please select the menu headings below. Please note that the number of places available for external participants is limited. In case of high demand, priority will be given to USI members.

Payment Methods

The invoice will be sent to the email address provided at the time of registration only after your course level has been confirmed, based on the result of the placement test held on the first day of class. Payment must be made within 10 days of the invoice date. The full amount must be paid in a single instalment by bank transfer or postal payment.

For further information, please contact external.language.services@usi.ch

Level

To identify the course that best suits your needs, we recommend checking your language level using the Self-assessment grid.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Reading the Frequently asked questions section helps to resolve doubts quickly at any time. To make it easier to find answers, the questions are divided into different topics.

Exam Centers

  • Università della Svizzera italiana - GOETHE-INSTITUT Svizzera italiana Exam Center

The Università della Svizzera italiana is an official Goethe-Institut Exam Center for the italian speaking part of Switzerland. Goethe-Institut exams are globally recognized as certifications of German language proficiency. Both USI members and external users can take the exams for a fee.

  • English language certificates

The main English language British certifications recognized internationally are:
IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is one of the world’s most popular tests for certifying English language proficiency. The IELTS certification is recognized by over 10,000 organizations worldwide. For information on IELTS test dates and locations: IELTS Switzerland – dates and locations
Cambridge English exams. For information on Cambridge test dates and locations: Cambridge Switzerland - dates and locations

  • Bellinzona - DELF DALF GRIGIONI E TICINO Exam Center

The DELF (Diplôme d'Études en Langue Française) and DALF (Diplôme Approfondi de Langue Française) diplomas are awarded by the French Ministry of National Education to certify competence in the French language. The DELF DALF Grigioni e Ticino Exam Center is located in Bellinzona but the September session takes place at Università della Svizzera italiana.
